# Canonical dialog renderer

`dialogcreator-renderer-*.tgz` is generated by DialogCreator, not maintained here.
The package-lock integrity pins its exact bytes. It contains the renderer's DOM
construction, UI behavior, attachment contract, localization, CSS, fonts and icons.
Its `provenance.json` identifies the owning source files and their SHA-256 hashes.

To update from a checked-out canonical source:

    node scripts/update-dialog-renderer.js /path/to/DialogCreator

Version changes belong in DialogCreator's `src/renderer/package.json`. Commit the
new archive and lockfile together; no sibling checkout is needed for installation,
building or execution. Never modify the installed/generated renderer or reintroduce
standard-control builders, label measurement, control styles or attachment engines
in DialogForge. Plot content and intentional product toolbar composition are host
extensions, using canonical control wrappers.
